column1: #   page title as read: "Official NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 11 of the 2026 Season | NFL.com"
#   the page's own heading is "Injuries - WEEK 11"; the week selector lists WEEK 1 .. WEEK 11.
# Read via the fetch tool, chunks 0-4 of 7, on 2026-11-19 (UTC) by session arena/427c1843-x1 (round 7).
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Every published injury table in this repository was a Week 10 read dated
# 2026-11-14/15. Week 11's first game is 2026-11-19 20:15 ET, so on the day this read was taken the
# live, decision-relevant report was Week 11's and the site carried none of it. This is that report.
# WHAT THE PAGE PRINTS. One block per club, five printed columns: Player | Position | Injuries |
# Practice Status | Game Status. Columns are transcribed exactly as printed. A blank cell means the
# page printed nothing there — it is NOT "healthy" and NOT "no injury". 26 of the 32 clubs have a
# block; CIN and WAS print the literal text "No Injuries Reported" (recorded in the notes file, not
# as rows). The six clubs on bye (ATL, CLE, GB, LA, SEA) have no block at all, and DEN's block is the
# only one that does not match the slate (see the publisher-error note below). Measured coverage:
# THE HEADLINE MEASUREMENT. 253 rows, 24 clubs, and only 16 carry any game designation
# (9 Out, 7 Questionable), all 16 belonging to the two Thursday-night clubs (IND, HOU). The other
# 24 clubs have published practice participation but no game status yet. That is the league's
# process, not a gap in this transcription, and it is the single fact that decides whether an
# injury feature can be built from this page alone: it cannot, until the Friday/Saturday updates.
# NAME/LINK MISMATCHES FOUND WHILE TRANSCRIBING (kept as printed, flagged not fixed):
# These are the published page's own strings. Neither the name nor the slug was corrected.
# ONE PROBABLE PUBLISHER ERROR, PUBLISHED RATHER THAN SILENTLY CORRECTED:
#   DEN lists "Jaylen Waddle" (WR). Waddle's own nfl.com player page and every other club block in
#   this same read place him with Miami, and the MIA block of this read does NOT list him. The row is
#   transcribed exactly as printed and flagged as F-R7-03 for review. It may be a misassigned row on
#   the official page; this repository does not resolve it, and no value is moved between clubs.
